snippet.title: Interaction Isn't Explicit。- Announcement Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
AVAILABLE NOW: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10009360

Developer's note:
Hi, while debating some aspects of game design with some friends, I thought it could be interesting to see if I could put my thoughts into something interactive. Figured I might as well publish it, so here's a little trailer for it.

This isn't a full game, just an interactive essay/study that shouldn't take more than 30 minutes to complete.

I also updated the demo for TUESDAY MORNING, for those interested.

Thanks a lot.

#ps5 #ps5games
